body:
## Purpose

Establish the two-point baseline on SemStreams before extraction, so every later difference on SemEngine is
attributable. Runs entirely on SemStreams and SemSource; **no dependency on SETUP 01 or 02**, proceed in parallel.

**Owner:** SemSource owner for the migration, Go developer for fixtures and measurement, independent Go reviewer for
evidence.
**Dependency:** plan merged (`3ae51c5`).

## Steps

- [x] Record the exact extraction pin: the newest SemStreams main commit at start, or the `v1.0.0-beta.163` tag if it
      has landed (ruling 1). A pin changes only by owner ruling.
- [x] Build the known-answer corpus: known entities, relationships, content and source locations, exact expected
      answers and explicit absence checks (plan, Consumer qualification evidence).
- [x] Run it on SemSource as it is today (`34bda640`, SemStreams beta.161) under each SemSource config a SemEngine
      tier will be compared against: structural tools under `tier0-statistical.json`, `tier0-statistical.json`,
      `tier1-semantic.json`.
- [x] For provider-backed configs, record before the first run and hold constant: service image or build, served model
      artifact and version, vector dimensions, query preprocessing. `SEMEMBED_MODEL` selects the model at startup; an
      unchanged SemSource config proves nothing about the model.
- [x] Migrate SemSource to the pin on SemStreams (at least 27 breaking port-set changes since beta.161; ADRs 094–107)
      and run the corpus again. Cross-repo work; tracked in SemSource.
- [x] Attribute every difference between the two runs to an ADR-documented upstream change or file it as a defect.
- [ ] Check whether the pin resolves semsource#178 (beta.161 GRAPH 256MiB ceiling regression on the OSH corpus tail).
- [x] Re-measure the dependency closure at the pin, including test-only dependencies, with commands recorded.

## Pass evidence

Recorded expectations and results on both SemStreams revisions for each compared config; provider identities recorded
and unchanged across runs; every difference attributed; closure measurement recorded with its commands. Reviewer
approves the baseline evidence.

## Children

Filled as the corpus and migration are scoped.

Plan: [SETUP 03A](https://github.com/C360Studio/semengine/blob/3ae51c5/docs/setup-plan.md#setup-03a-pinned-consumer-baseline). Rulings: https://github.com/C360Studio/semengine/pull/1#issuecomment-5917717356.

## SETUP 03A execution and acceptance record — 2026-09-30

Consumer work is delivered in [SemSource draft PR #213](https://github.com/C360Studio/semsource/pull/213),
tracking [SemSource #212](https://github.com/C360Studio/semsource/issues/212). The checked steps above
record completed execution on that branch, not a merged migration or full product qualification.

- Frozen shared extraction/migration SHA: `8b99efe9c66a4faa4fa509f9f62cc6bad8392128`. `beta.163` was absent when work began.
- Exact module: `v1.0.0-beta.162.0.20260930150212-8b99efe9c66a`.
- Before: beta.161, `9d0ff67f377ea3dd82dca2f3bf614871c0100766`, SemSource `34bda640`.
- Evidence-bearing branch snapshot: `75a17f7d6297c3fa18102f3e09f8a0a4a10750bf`; the pre-upgrade corpus/baseline was committed first.
- BM25 55/57 → 61/63; real semembed 59/61 → 65/67; provider-fault supplement 6/6 at both points.
  The target adds six authority assertions. The same two broker-recovery expectations fail at both pins.
- Served image/build/model artifact, 384 dimensions, and preprocessing were held constant and verified.
- Full retained-package tagged test closure: 110 packages / 218,808 non-test lines → 114 / 232,126.
  Production port set: 63 → 65 packages; #8 owns admission of the measured increase.
- Guarded OSH delivery passes at both pins, but the original 77,802-message capacity regression remains
  unresolved in [SemSource #178](https://github.com/C360Studio/semsource/issues/178); its step stays open.

[Compatibility and attribution](https://github.com/C360Studio/semsource/blob/75a17f7d6297c3fa18102f3e09f8a0a4a10750bf/docs/testing/setup-03a/compatibility.md) · [Exact pins](https://github.com/C360Studio/semsource/blob/75a17f7d6297c3fa18102f3e09f8a0a4a10750bf/docs/testing/setup-03a/pins.json) ·
[Before](https://github.com/C360Studio/semsource/blob/75a17f7d6297c3fa18102f3e09f8a0a4a10750bf/docs/testing/setup-03a/baseline-results.json) · [After](https://github.com/C360Studio/semsource/blob/75a17f7d6297c3fa18102f3e09f8a0a4a10750bf/docs/testing/setup-03a/pinned-results.json) ·
[Dependency measurement](https://github.com/C360Studio/semsource/blob/75a17f7d6297c3fa18102f3e09f8a0a4a10750bf/docs/testing/setup-03a/dependency-results.json) · [Independent review](https://github.com/C360Studio/semsource/blob/75a17f7d6297c3fa18102f3e09f8a0a4a10750bf/docs/testing/setup-03a/review.md).

The historical evidence review approved the comparison and scoped implementation while withholding
merge/qualification. The 2026-10-01 owner ruling below now reconciles baseline-only acceptance and
SemSource merge readiness. System qualification, SemEngine tier admission and substrate cutover remain
separate; historical failed evidence is unchanged.

- [x] Record the owner/reviewer disposition against SETUP 03A's baseline-evidence criteria, including the
      unresolved original-capacity question; distinguish it from SemSource merge and later tier acceptance.
- [x] Reconcile the shared review/OpenSpec acceptance wording without waiving any failing behavior test.
- [ ] Confirm #6 sign-off separately before declaring #8 unlocked; #6 is currently claimed by PR #13.

Required substrate repair rows are now tracked by #15 (stream-generation recovery) and #16 (RPC overlap).
This update records evidence and queues decisions; it does not change the pin, close this epic, or claim #8.

## Owner/reviewer baseline acceptance — 2026-10-01

The owner directed SemSource #213 to become merge-ready and then stop. Independent Go/component and
graph/event reviewers approved baseline-only readiness at `705ae66`; the follow-up is documentation
only. [Current SemSource disposition](https://github.com/C360Studio/semsource/blob/ae69d1ab22f8c7692227576cbf2b05efefee11d7/docs/testing/setup-03a/merge-readiness.md) supersedes the earlier draft/merge hold without changing
any measured result. This accepts the recorded two-point baseline, not broken guarantees in SemEngine.

The exact `broker_restart_reingested_exact_relationship` and `broker_restart_reingested_exact_content`
failures remain **known-at-pin** at both revisions: SemStreams #1442 → #15. Retain SemSource's tested
`Enabled:false` envelope workaround: SemStreams #1443 → #17. RPC overlap remains #16. The later lifecycle
gaps are #18–#20 contract decisions under #8, not promises of implemented fixes. SemSource #215 remains
open; its positive selective reactivation result remains 24/26. No SemStreams patch or pin change is
awaited by the baseline merge.

The original capacity investigation remains open in SemSource #178, and #8 still owns the 65-versus-63
package admission decision. This update neither closes this epic nor declares #6/#8 gates satisfied.
SemSource next consumes Tier 0 at 04A using `test/setup03a` on an exclusive SemEngine branch with a true
no-embedder composition. The graph-foundation workload, including the two named recovery failures,
must pass there; lexical/neural cases retain 04B/04C gates. Mainline stays on SemStreams until the full
semembed-backed 04C workload passes. No extraction/04A implementation is authorized by this record.

comments.body: SemSource-side tracking issue for the migration step: https://github.com/C360Studio/semsource/issues/212

Status 2026-09-30: the SemSource migration step (semsource#212) is being worked by Codex. Nothing on this epic's SemEngine side (corpus, closure re-measurement at the pin) has started; the pin itself is recorded when 03A begins.

Status 2026-10-01 (Claude session, read-only check of the Codex migration findings; no rulings taken).

**Pin consistency.** The recorded migration/extraction SHA `8b99efe9c66a4faa4fa509f9f62cc6bad8392128` is SemStreams `origin/main` HEAD today (`v1.0.0-beta.162-96-g8b99efe9`, 0 commits behind), so it matches ruling 1 (newest main at start; `beta.163` absent). It is one commit after `5457b3458936f668b71d2fea061f67f8d7d01e67`, the SHA the SETUP 02 admission ledger (`docs/admission-ledger.yaml`, merged in #13 / `34c9dc6`) cites for its 12 rows. That commit (`test(e2e): required-check evidence (#1222) (#1406)`) touches none of the 12 ledger `source_path`s, and the Docker `--filter name=` destroyer set SemEngine's naming invariant forbids is identical at both SHAs. No ledger drift; the ledger rows stay cited at `5457b345`. Ratifying `8b99efe9` as the pin is an owner ruling still owed on this issue (the body records it as execution, not a ruling).

**SemStreams issues filed from the migration** (all unlabeled in SemStreams; SemEngine homes as of now):

| SemStreams | Kind at the pin | SemEngine home |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #1442 graph-ingest applied sequence rejects recovery after memory GRAPH recreation | reproduced defect, both pins | #15 (repair-before-port, blocked on #8) |
| #1143 persisted stream overlap with reserved RPC subjects | reproduced defect, both pins | #16 (repair-before-port, blocked on #8) |
| #1443 ConfigManager: deleted file-defined component returns after restart | reproduced defect (`config/manager.go` `syncFromKV` does not replay the deletion) | **none yet** |
| #1444 graph-ingest applied-input barrier for retired-source completion | framework contract request | **none yet** |
| #1445 projection: conditional reconcile at a caller-observed revision (TOCTOU) | framework contract request | **none yet** |
| #1446 projection: unknown mutation outcomes classified as not-committed | framework contract request | **none yet** |

Under the frozen-pin fix flow (plan ruling; fixes land in SemEngine as admission work, SemStreams is not patched for the port), the four without a home need one before #8's retained-contract matrix closes: #1443 as a third repair-before-port row candidate (`config` is in the port set), #1444–#1446 as contract-matrix inputs on #8 (`status:needs-decision`). Not filed here to avoid duplicating Codex's in-flight work on semsource#213/#215.

**Open on this epic:** semsource#178 step; SemSource PR #213 is still a draft, so the checked steps describe branch evidence, not a merged migration; the pass-evidence line "Reviewer approves the baseline evidence" rests on the SemSource-side review record linked above — whether that satisfies this epic's reviewer requirement is the owner's call.

Homes filed for the four findings marked **none yet** above: SemStreams #1443 → #17 (repair-before-port, blocked on #8); #1444 → #18, #1445 → #19, #1446 → #20 (`status:needs-decision`, inputs to #8's matrix). #8's body lists the mapping tasks. SemStreams itself stays unpatched and unlabeled by agents (sister repo).

**Owner rulings 2026-10-01** (posted by the Claude session on the owner's word; the owner's instruction is authority).

1. **Pin ratified.** The extraction pin is SemStreams `8b99efe9c66a4faa4fa509f9f62cc6bad8392128` (`v1.0.0-beta.162.0.20260930150212-8b99efe9c66a`), newest main at 03A start per ruling 1; `beta.163` was absent. It changes only by owner ruling. The admission-ledger rows cited at `5457b345` stand (verified: no `source_path` or destroyer-set drift between the two SHAs).

2. **03A evidence accepted at branch level.** The SemSource-side review record at `75a17f7d` satisfies this epic's reviewer line for the two-point baseline. The step stays open only for semsource#178; semsource#213 merging is SemSource's gate, not this epic's. **#8 may start.**

3. Epic #6 is closed by the owner on PR #13's merge (`34c9dc6`); see #6.
